summary: Serve the attention, summary, glasses and arrangements collections from views one background refresher publishes, so collection windows never fold them

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored history changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Attention, summary, glasses and arrangements windows are answered from views a background refresher publishes, fenced at that view's own snapshot index and carrying the existing optional published_at time. Rows are unchanged. Before a view's first publication (or a summary selection's first computation) the window gets a retryable resync. Setting ST3_ATTENTION_LIST=off on the daemon restores per-window reads.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or startup migration is required. The daemon folds the views in the background as it starts.

recovery.detail: Only volatile in-memory caches change; reverting, or ST3_ATTENTION_LIST=off, restores per-window reads.
